Rajiv Pandita Bengalûru, India | +91-7259299777 | rajivpandita@gmail.com

Versatile IT Leader | 17+ Years of Global Delivery Expertise

Specializes in Project Management Excellence, Client Relationship Leadership, High-Impact People Management, Fraud Prevention, Regulatory Compliance, and Seamless Execution across Financial, Banking, and Healthcare domains.

Results-driven Technical Delivery Manager with strong experience leading complex technology initiatives and delivering large-scale cloud-native and event-driven platforms. Proven track record of managing end-to-end delivery across cross- functional engineering teams, ensuring predictable execution, high-quality releases, and alignment with strategic business goals.

Drives delivery excellence using Agile methodologies, OKRs, and data-driven engineering metrics to improve efficiency and operational outcomes.

Leveraged Agile-DevOps practices and AI-powered tools, including GitHub Copilot, and Claude, to accelerate development cycles and enhance code quality.

KEY WINS

▪ Reduced incident volumes to near zero across the APAC region by proactively resolving aged incidents (30–60+ days)

and driving effective incident management.

▪ Enabled application maturity advancement across the APAC Innovation & Platforms portfolio through disciplined

delivery management and continuous improvement initiatives.

▪ Boosted CBA's Net Promoter Score (NPS) by designing and delivering innovative features, enhancing customer

satisfaction.

▪ Delivered high-quality digital banking solutions ahead of deadlines at CBA through expert project planning and team

leadership.

AREAS OF EXPERTISE

Project Management ★Agile-DevOps Methodologies ★ Scrum Mastery ★ Client & Stakeholder Coordination ★ Digital Applications (iOS & Android) ★ Accessibility ★ Team Building & Mentorship ★ Strategic Planning ★ Business Process Integration ★ Release Scheduling ★ JIRA Proficiency ★ Cross-Functional Collaboration ★ Resource Projection

WORK EXPERIENCE

IG Group, Bengaluru Technical Delivery Manager

Mar 2026 - Present

Successfully led delivery across the APAC Innovation & Platforms portfolio, driving execution and governance. Improved service stability by reducing incidents to near zero, resolved long-pending issues, strengthened security through timely vulnerability remediation, and enhanced stakeholder communication with effective status reporting.

Successfully contributed to reducing incident counts to near zero across multiple regions (APAC), including resolving aged incidents (30–60+ days) identified in IM.

Proactively monitored Wiz vulnerabilities and ensured timely remediation, strengthening overall security posture and compliance

Managed and streamlined weekly and monthly status reporting using AI (Claude), improving visibility and stakeholder communication

Managed delivery for the APAC Innovation and Platforms portfolio, driving coordination and progress.

Successfully managed Agile Scrum teams and delivered multiple projects across geographically diverse regions worldwide.

Facilitating Agile ceremonies, removing impediments, and enabling efficient sprint planning and execution

• Collaborated closely with engineering teams and vendors to proactively remove blockers, optimize

resource allocation, and ensure uninterrupted project delivery.

Reduced manual follow-ups by setting up automated reminders for all the teams to improve reporting discipline.

Used AI tools to consolidate data from multiple sources into structured insights.

Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Bengaluru Senior Consultant

Dec 2023 - Aug 2025

Led successful project delivery using Agile methodologies, overseeing release planning, coordination, and execution to ensure timely and high-quality outcomes. Strengthened engineering efficiency by promoting DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines, enabling faster, reliable software releases and improved deployment consistency. Enhanced collaboration, version control, and code integration using GitHub, supporting automated build and deployment processes and contributing to efficient delivery cycles and operational excellence.

▪ Championed fraud prevention and quality assurance for a leading multinational bank with operations spanning New

Zealand and Australia

▪ Led fraud detection initiatives by collaborating with third-party partner Biocatch, strengthening security measures ▪ Coordinated multi-time zone collaboration across India and Australia teams ▪ Balanced planned roadmap delivery with regulatory, compliance, and security-driven work-streams ▪ Partnered with Heads of Technology to execute strategic initiatives and ensure timely delivery ▪ Identified and resolved cross-team dependencies, reducing delivery blockers by 30% ▪ Translated complex technical and regulatory requirements into actionable delivery plans ▪ Optimized backlog management and facilitated refinement sessions, boosting project efficiency

NTT Data, Bengaluru Senior Consultant Lead

Oct 2015 - Dec 2023

Showcased excellence in leadership while delivering top-quality applications for global financial and healthcare clients. Managed testing processes using JIRA, drove Agile practices as Scrum Master, and excelled in client management, fostering strong stakeholder relationships across the US and India to ensure project success.

Client Engagements:

▪ Blue Cross Blue Shield (Rhode Island): Sep 2022 - Nov 2023 ▪ Optum Financial (formerly ConnectYourCare): Dec 2017 - Aug 2022 ▪ Wells Fargo: Oct 2015 - Nov 2017 ▪ Directed a high-performing team of 15 Analysts, guaranteeing exceptional application quality and integrity across the

entire software development lifecycle

▪ Enabled effective delivery by synchronizing teams across India, USA and UK time zones ▪ Led multi-squad, cross-functional technology delivery programs ensuring predictable execution and alignment with

business priorities

▪ Coordinated dependencies across Product, Architecture, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Data, Infrastructure, and

Regulatory teams

▪ Maintained delivery transparency through Agile frameworks, JIRA tracking, and automated reporting dashboards ▪ Coordinated technology delivery that adheres to regulatory and compliance frameworks integrated into the platform

architecture

▪ Delivered executive-level reporting to regional and global leadership ▪ Facilitated stakeholder alignment across engineering, product, and compliance teams ▪ Led planning, estimation, and discovery workshops for new initiatives

JP Morgan, Bengaluru Automation Tester

Aug 2013 - Feb 2015

▪ Pioneered automation testing for the IDDA platform, managing cash accounts for the international wholesale bank

using the Temenos-T24 package

▪ Mastered Temenos-T24, world's leading retail banking solution, ensuring robust testing for modern banking needs

▪ Developed advanced test scripts using Rational Integration Tool (formerly Green Hat), enhancing system integration

efficiency

Capgemini India Pvt Ltd, Pune Associate Consultant

Apr 2008 - Apr 2013

▪ Supported TransUnion, a leading US credit bureau, by ensuring the reliability of customer credit history applications ▪ Designed intricate test cases for complex service requests, addressing inter-component and inter-system interactions ▪ Led as an Onsite Coordinator in Chicago, USA, fostering seamless client collaboration and project execution

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Project Tools: JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, MS Project

Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, DevOps

Cloud: AWS, API Gateway

DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions

Languages: Java, Python

AI Tools: Claude, APIs, GitHub Copilot, Power Automate

CERTIFICATIONS & LEARNING

▪ AI for Everyone – DeepLearning.AI ▪ Prompt Engineering for ChatGPT – GreatLearning Academy ▪ Generative AI Overview for Project Managers – PMI

EDUCATION

B. Engineering – Information Technology, Pune University
